apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.2.1 — Varisai fixes: the highlight is now derived from the playback timeline by a single ticker (no drift, no skipped tokens); the pattern menu no longer flickers during playback; Sa/Speed/Labels are the web three-dropdown bar with the web tempo row; the Laya and Tala info is the web boxed component with group boxes and the tala beat math.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Varisai highlight sync, menu flicker, web controls + laya/tala boxes.
